name: mcp-hub
description: A persistent local hub that proxies every MCP server and manages their credentials in memory.

scripts.build:app: npm run build -w @mcp-hub/ui && npm run build:sidecars && npm run build -w @mcp-hub/desktop && node scripts/collect-dist.mjs
scripts.build:app:debug: npm run build -w @mcp-hub/ui && npm run build:sidecars && npm run build -w @mcp-hub/desktop -- --debug --bundles app && node scripts/collect-dist.mjs --debug
